company.name: Expanse
company.shortDescription: Expanse is an enterprise software company that provides an updated view of all internet-connected assets that belong to an organization.
company.description:
Expanse is an enterprise software company that provides an updated view of all internet-connected assets that belong to an organization. It provides IT and security teams with visibility into their global internet attack surface, helping them discover unknown assets and reduce and manage their exposure to online threats. Expanse is trusted by some of the world’s largest enterprises and government agencies to monitor and track more than 400 million Internet- and cloud-connected assets comprising more than 10% of the global Internet. Using leading-edge collection and analysis technology, Expanse will improve any organization’s awareness and visibility to help prevent successful attacks. 

Founded in 2012, Expanse is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
